thread:
Lena Ortiz: hey folks, first week here — two quick things: 1) where do i post design feedback vs implementation questions? 2) how do i dial down notifications (i'm on CET and wake up early). also the standup bot pinged me twice?

Ben C.: welcome Lena :wave: quick map: design feedback -> #design (or tag @design-team), implementation/SDK questions -> #eng, infra/VPN/laptop -> #help-it tag @IT Support, and finance/expense questions -> #finance.

Ben C.: for design feedback, prefer a short root msg with attachments or Figma links, then ask for async comments rather than pinging people repeatedly. Example: "Design: onboarding modal (Figma link) — feedback by EOD Wed"

Lena Ortiz: got it — and notifications?

Onboarding Bot: Hi Lena! :sparkles: To control onboarding pings: DM me `prefs` and set `hours` (e.g., 09:00-17:00 PT) or run `/onboard snooze 3d`. For channel notifications click channel name -> Notification preferences -> Mute/Only mentions.

Standup Bot: automatic: Standup reminders are scheduled per-team. To change your standup time DM me `standup set 09:30 CET` or run `/standup prefs` in the team channel.

Lena Ortiz: nice — i changed standup to 09:30 CET and muted daily tips. thanks. one more: the workspace has a lot of channels; any naming conventions i should know?

Ben C.: yes — channel prefixes help: `eng-` for engineering subteams (eng-runtime, eng-platform), `eng-` also for infra ops, `product-` for cross-functional product spaces, `proj-` for short-lived project channels, `ops-` for oncall/incident. Public vs private: most team channels are private; if you see a locked padlock it's invite-only.

IT Support: for any hardware/VPN issue, include these in your first message: OS, serial (if laptop), and a short screenshot or copy of the terminal error. Example paste: 

IT Support: ```
OS: Ubuntu 22.04
Issue: can't mount network drive (permission denied)
Cmd: mount \/mnt\/share
Error: permission denied (code 13)
```

Finance Bot: automated: Expense submissions go through `/expense submit` in the #finance channel or DM me `policy` to see limits. For reimbursements include receipt image and project tag.

Lena Ortiz: this is great — appreciate the channel map and the mute tips. i'll add timezone to my profile and try to keep threads tidy. :thumbsup:

Ben C.: pro-tip: put a 1-line subject in the root message for longer threads (e.g., "Design: onboarding modal feedback") so people know what to skim. React with :white_check_mark: when resolved. welcome again!
